description: This Java source file defines the RssReader activity for an Android app, demonstrating background RSS data download, parsing with XmlPullParser, custom list display, and state preservation.

classes.name: RssReader
classes.description: Main activity class for RSS reader app, managing UI, background thread, and RSS data parsing.

classes.name: RSSListAdapter
classes.description: Custom ArrayAdapter for displaying RssItem objects in a ListView.

classes.name: ItemAdder
classes.description: Runnable to add RssItem to UI from background thread.

classes.name: RSSWorker
classes.description: Background thread class for downloading and parsing RSS feed data.

classes.name: RSSMenu
classes.description: Menu item click listener to set RSS URL in the input field.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, adapter, UI elements, and button click handler.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Overrides ArrayAdapter.getView to display RssItem title and description.

methods.name: removeTags
methods.description: Removes HTML tags from a string to display plain text.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles list item clicks to open RSS item link in browser.

methods.name: resetUI
methods.description: Clears list and resets UI elements.

methods.name: setCurrentWorker
methods.description: Sets the active background worker thread, interrupting previous if any.

methods.name: isCurrentWorker
methods.description: Checks if a given worker is the current active thread.

methods.name: doRSS
methods.description: Starts a new RSSWorker thread to download and parse RSS data.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates menu with preset RSS feed URLs and reset option.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current list items, selection, URL, and status for activity restoration.

methods.name: onRestoreInstanceState
methods.description: Restores list items, selection, URL, and status from saved state.

methods.name: parseRSS
methods.description: Parses RSS feed InputStream using XmlPullParser, posts RssItems to UI.
